key_idea: Walk along each path like the mouse and count the right turns and the left turns.
steps: Start at the green circle and say right or left at every corner, facing the way the mouse walks.
On path C the mouse walks down, then turns right, then right again. Then he turns left, left, and left to reach the orange square.
That is 2 right turns and 3 left turns.

choice_feedback.A: Path A has 2 right turns but only 2 left turns.
choice_feedback.B: Path B has 4 left turns and no right turns.
choice_feedback.D: Path D has 3 right turns and 2 left turns. That is the wrong way round.
choice_feedback.E: Path E has 4 right turns and no left turns.
